definitions.gloss: person sensitive to the heat; someone who feels the heat easily
definitions.explanation: Describes someone who tends to feel hot more than others and is quick to seek cool air or remove layers.

examples.japanese: {暑|あつ}がりなので、{夏|なつ}はエアコンが{欠|か}かせない。
examples.english: Since I'm sensitive to heat, air conditioning is essential in summer.

examples.japanese: {暑|あつ}がりの{息子|むすこ}は、{真冬|まふゆ}でも{半袖|はんそで}で{出|で}かけようとする。
examples.english: My heat-sensitive son tries to go out in short sleeves even in the dead of winter.

notes:
USAGE:
Formed from {暑|あつ}い + がる + nominal suffix. Used both as a noun and as a na-adjective. The counterpart is {寒|さむ}がり (person sensitive to cold).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {暑|あつ}がりの{人|ひと} (a heat-sensitive person)
- {暑|あつ}がりで{汗|あせ}っかき (sensitive to heat and sweats easily)
